assessments.reasoning: The manual gives RegexMatch when a match occurs and explicitly describes nothing when no match occurs. The Base docstring independently agrees within the same publication chain.

challenge.method: Contrast matching and nonmatching strings with occursin, and distinguish the no-match value from an empty match.
challenge.results: The documented result distinguishes match information from nothing. The separate Boolean function is occursin, and an empty successful match still belongs to the match case.

limitations: This is the documented match interface. Engine behavior, invalid patterns, and independent corroboration from the same tree are outside it.
